messages:
Alex (PM): Quick heads-up — last week's full-stack benchmark exposed a tail-latency regression. p95 went from ~120ms -> ~420ms for typical 1k-token requests under load. I think we have to choose: (A) slide launch by 1 week and add a temporary worker bump, or (B) keep current date and cut two noncritical UX features. Need a decision by EOD so I can update roadmap and tell pilots.

Maya (Eng): Oof. Do we know root cause? batching inefficiency or KV cache churn?

Juan (SRE): Mainly bursty prefixes causing cache misses + longer KV rebuilds. Also some unexpected GC events on the runtime during long sequences.

Maya (Eng): For quick wins we can: 1) enable prefer-latency routing for the launch pool, 2) tighten batching window from 25ms -> 15ms for low latency tier, 3) enable aggressive prefix caching for known pilot prefixes. Those are deployable in ~48h but increase cost.

Sam (Product): We can't cut streaming or tool-calling — pilot customers require them. Which UX things are "noncritical"?

Alex (PM): Candidate cuts: - Save/restore prompt sets (full UX) - Advanced per-route analytics dashboard (detailed charts) Both are v1 aims, not core MVP behavior. If we cut them to hit date we keep streaming/tool-calls and rollout.

Linh (Design): Save/restore is a big piece of work (frontend + backend). If we defer, we should ship a minimal "export" CSV/ZIP CTA so power users aren't blocked. That could be a day or two of effort.

Juan (SRE): My strong preference is B (keep date + cuts) if we can also deploy a short-term infra mitigation: canary pilot on a separate pool and routing tweaks. That keeps customers happy and contains blast radius.

Maya (Eng): I'm leaning B too if we accept the temporary cost hit plan Juan & I described. Need signoff to run prefer-latency routing and bump pool by ~20% during launch window.

Sam (Product): B from me. We'll prepare pilot comms noting saved features move to v1 and offer opt-in early access later.

Linh (Design): B but prefer we do the quick "export" CTA instead of full save/restore. I'll mock a minimal UI and copy for the comms doc.

Alex (PM): OK consensus = B. Action items by tomorrow noon: @Maya implement routing + batching change and prepare rollback knobs; @Juan create canary pool + isolation config; @Linh design export CTA and copy; @Sam craft pilot message and FAQ blurb. I'll update roadmap artifact and tell Execs about the cut (callout: cost delta for routing + pool).

Maya (Eng): Will start on the routing PR now. I’ll post perf numbers as soon as the canary runs.

deploy-bot: Canary pool "launch-pilot-01" created (id cp-42) — note: retention rule applied.

Alex (PM): Thanks all. We'll reconvene tomorrow 10:30 for a go/no-go checkin.

Juan (SRE): Adding note: if the canary shows repeated GC spikes we abort and fall back to the timeline slip — will notify via this thread.

Maya (Eng): Ack.

Sam (Product): Thanks, team :thumbsup:
